title: Fashionable Woman, Tiki Bamboo Entrance - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A cheerful young woman stands outdoors beside a shop or restaurant entrance paneled in distinctive diagonal bamboo stalks, reflecting the mid-century Polynesian and Tiki craze popular in post-WWII America. She is dressed in stylish resort-casual attire, including a patterned short-sleeved collared blouse tucked into high-waisted pleated trousers secured with a thin belt, accessorized with a light beret or cap. A shop window to her right faintly displays vintage swimsuit advertisements.
